verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a database product. The docs serve a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at docs.trychroma.com/openapi.json, and the getting-started and query docs show usage examples. That is a foundation for an API reference, but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive reference or examples users can run in the browser. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API explorer, runnable or try-it-now examples in the reference, and independent corroboration of the reference experience.
